claims.text: NeuronBlocks includes a suite of neural network modules categorized in the Block Zoo, which contains standard and reusable blocks such as embedding, CNN, RNN, and Transformer.
The toolkit allows for flexible combinations of layers/blocks, such as word/character embedding, CNN/LSTM, and CRF, to construct complex network architectures.
